headline: Expiry‑day trades are a major source of loss

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: Your expiry‑day trades cost you ₹1,16,891 across 90 trades. On average each of those trades lost ₹1,299, had a win rate of 29% and produced a 28% loss, while the remaining 124 trades averaged a loss of ₹449, a 5% loss and a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying this rule to your next window's expiry‑day trades.
